{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Identify the most recent sample_seq for each patient (highest sample_seq)
data_sorted = data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
data_deduped = data_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Now compute response rates using only the latest sample for each patient
treatment_response_rate_deduped = data_deduped[data_deduped['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
control_response_rate_deduped = data_deduped[data_deduped['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

treatment_response_rate_deduped, control_response_rate_deduped"}
